title: Terms of Stay: The Resort or Destination Fee on Guest Folios
content:
**Clause.** At Ashbury brands whose resort fee per night is above zero, the night audit posts the resort fee to the Guest Folio for every night actually stayed and, where the brand's fee bears room tax, a resort fee tax line at the reservation's tax rate, rounded to the cent. Where the brand charges no resort fee on reward nights, no resort fee is posted for nights paid with points or Free Night Awards, which on the folio are the nights of a Reward Night Rate reservation. Where the brand charges the fee only for nights stayed, no fee is posted for nights after the actual check-out date. The fee covers the inclusions of the brand, among them self-parking where self-parking is included in the brand's resort fee, and is not reduced because the guest did not use an inclusion. Resort fees are posted only to a folio whose status is open.

Each brand's figures for this clause — its fee per night, whether the fee is taxable, whether reward nights are free of the fee, and whether the fee follows nights stayed only — are that brand's figures in the resort and destination fee table.

## The clause night by night

| Night on the folio | Resort fee line | Resort fee tax line |
|---|---|---|
| Night stayed, brand fee above zero, not a reward night | The brand's fee | Where the fee is taxable: the fee multiplied by the reservation's tax rate, rounded to the cent |
| Night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, at a brand that charges no fee on reward nights | None | None |
| Night after the actual check-out date, at a brand that charges only nights stayed | None | None |
| Any night, brand fee of zero | None | None |

## Points of judgement

- **The guest did not use the pool or did not park.** The fee is not reduced because an inclusion went unused.
- **Self-parking at a brand where it is a resort fee inclusion.** It is covered by the resort fee.
- **Status of the folio.** Resort fee lines are posted only while the folio is open.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fee of $45.00 on a reservation with a tax rate of 11.25% posts, for a night stayed, a resort fee line of $45.00 and a resort fee tax line of $5.06 ($45.00 multiplied by 11.25% is $5.0625, rounded to the cent). A reservation on the Reward Night Rate at the same brand carries neither line for its nights.
